krishi-vidya-nidhi-yojana-odisha._reviewed: 2026-10-21 (CNT-112): the old text said 'up to ₹10,000/year', which no source supports. Official press release (Odisha Information & Public Relations, 28-03-2025): fee support, actual course fee in government institutions, capped per course in private ones (B.Tech ₹60,000, M.Tech ₹66,000, MBA ₹65,000, medical 4-5 yrs ₹37,950, B.Pharma ₹35,000, nursing ₹19,450, 2-yr medical ₹58,000, architecture ₹60,000), for sons/daughters of CM-KISAN beneficiaries. NOT changed: amount_annual 100000 / amount_min 5000 / the ₹1,00,000 premier-institution cap, which appear only on secondary sites and are not confirmed on an official page.
